item.title: WordPress Refresh & Graphics for 2iC Global
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | Project overview We're refreshing the website for 2iC Global (2icglobal.com), a recruitment and professional services transformation consultancy. The site is built on WordPress and needs a content and visual refresh, not a full rebuild. We're looking for someone with both WordPress skills and genuine graphic design ability, since a strong part of this project is visual: a new hero image and a general refresh of the site's look. We will provide the updated written content.
Before applying, please review the current live site at 2icglobal.com and confirm in your application that you've looked at it and understand what's there now.
Scope of work >Refresh existing page content across the site with updated copy (copy will be supplied) >Design and add new images throughout the site, including a new hero image for the homepage >Build one new category/service page from scratch, matching the site's structure and style >General visual refresh: making sure typography, colours and layout feel current and consistent across pages >Work within the existing WordPress setup (no migration to a new platform)
What we need from you >Solid WordPress experience (theme customisation, page building, image handling) >Genuine graphic design skills, not just template assembly. We need someone who can create a strong hero image and supporting visuals, not just drop in stock photos >A portfolio showing both web design work and standalone graphic design work >Comfortable working from a brand palette and font we'll provide >Available for a few live working sessions on Zoom during the project, so strong spoken English is required
Deliverables >Refreshed homepage and existing pages with new copy and images in place >New hero image, designed to fit the brand >One new, fully built category/service page
SEO and AOI experience would also be a plus to revisit and update the keywords on existing pages
How to apply Please include: >Confirmation you've reviewed 2icglobal.com and a couple of lines on what you'd focus on first >Links to relevant WordPress and graphic design work >Your availability for live Zoom sessions and your spoken English level >Your estimated timeline and rate for the scope above
Julie & Leanne

item.title: B2B Web Developer Needed: Premium Product Showroom with Dropbox API Integration (No E-Commerce)
item.description:
1500-3000 AUD | We are a premier Australian manufacturer and wholesaler of Hush acoustic panels and desk screens.
We sell strictly B2B / Trade-only (architects, designers, and commercial fit-out companies). We do not sell to the public and do not require a shopping cart/e-commerce system.
We require a high-end, clean, corporate website that acts as a digital product showroom.
Key Requirements:
Premium Digital Showroom: Visual-first product catalog focusing on high-quality imagery, product specifications, and acoustic data.
Dynamic Dropbox Integration: We have a large Dropbox folder with high-res images, CAD files, and technical spec sheets. The website must interface dynamically with this Dropbox repository via API so updates in Dropbox sync to the website download sections seamlessly.Lead Generation & Quote
Trade Portal (Gated Asset Area): A secure login area where approved trade clients can download price lists and technical spec sheets.
Responsive Design: Must look flawless on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
What we will provide:Comprehensive 4-page Website Design Brief (PDF attached).High-res brand guidelines, logo assets, and product brochures.Access to the Dropbox repository.
Screening Questions Please explain your specific experience with the Dropbox API. How do you plan to handle the dynamic syncing of high-res images and CAD files to the front end without slowing down the site loading speeds?
We are a B2B trade-only manufacturer, not a consumer e-commerce store. What is your approach to building a site like this.
To prove you have read our description and the attached brief, please start your bid response with the word 'ACOUSTIC'.

item.title: Website Payment Integration & Cart
item.description:
250-750 USD | I want my website to accept payments smoothly through PayPal, Stripe and a standard merchant gateway. Because I do not yet have accounts with either PayPal or Stripe, the first step will be walking me through the sign-up and verification process for each platform, making sure all business information matches what the processors require so there are no surprise holds later on.
The site will sell services only, so the shopping cart can stay lean—just enough to let a visitor pick a service, see the price, and check out. Once payment clears, I need an automatic confirmation email to both the buyer and me, plus a simple dashboard or log where I can review transactions at a glance.
Security and reliability are key. Please follow the usual PCI-compliant best practices, load test in a sandbox, and leave detailed notes so I can manage routine changes myself after launch.
Deliverables • Fully configured PayPal, Stripe and merchant account credentials connected to the site • Lightweight shopping cart for service checkout • Success / failure callbacks that update an order record and trigger emails • End-to-end sandbox test results with screencaps or logs • Clear hand-off documentation covering settings, API keys, and how to add or edit services
If you have questions about my current tech stack, let me know; I’m flexible on libraries and can give FTP or admin access as soon as we agree on the approach.

item.title: Toronto Courier SEO + Hostinger Website + Instant Delivery Booking System
item.description:
1500-3000 CAD | I own Cargaroo.ca, a Toronto-based same-day courier and business delivery company.
My website is built and hosted on HOSTINGER.
I am looking for an experienced SEO + Website Optimization + Web Development specialist who can improve the actual website, increase Google visibility, and help generate real courier leads and customers.
MAIN GOALS
- Rank higher for Toronto courier/delivery searches - Generate real calls, quote requests and bookings - Improve the design and professionalism of Cargaroo.ca - Fix technical SEO/indexing issues - Improve Google Business Profile/local visibility - Build an instant delivery price calculator and online booking/payment system if possible - Track leads and conversions
IMPORTANT: I do NOT want someone who only sends me an SEO audit. I need someone who can actually make the changes to my Hostinger website.
My main objective is CLIENTS and BOOKINGS, not just traffic.
TARGET KEYWORDS
Examples:
- courier service Toronto - courier Toronto - same day courier Toronto - delivery service Toronto - same day delivery Toronto - business courier Toronto - business delivery Toronto - rush courier Toronto - courier service North York - same day courier GTA
I am open to additional keyword recommendations based on proper research.
HOSTINGER WEBSITE
You should have experience with Hostinger websites or be confident working with my existing Hostinger website.
I do NOT want the website moved to another platform unless you explain why and I approve it first.
WEBSITE DESIGN + CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION
I want Cargaroo.ca to look like a professional and trustworthy Toronto courier company.
Work may include:
- Improve homepage design - Improve mobile design - Improve navigation - Improve website speed - Improve professional appearance - Improve H1/H2/H3 structure - Rewrite/improve website copy - Improve calls-to-action - Improve quote/contact buttons - Add strong Get Instant Price / Book Delivery buttons - Improve phone and WhatsApp visibility - Improve forms - Improve trust sections - Improve service descriptions - Improve internal linking - Fix broken links - Fix duplicate content - Optimize images - Improve title tags and meta descriptions - Improve URL structure where necessary - Improve conversion rate
I am NOT automatically asking for a full website rebuild. Improve the existing website where possible.
HOMEPAGE DIRECTION
The homepage should clearly communicate:
“Same-Day Courier & Business Delivery in Toronto & the GTA”
Customers should quickly understand:
- What Cargaroo does - Where we deliver - How quickly we deliver - Why they should trust us - How to get a price - How to book - How to request recurring/business pricing
Important buttons:
GET AN INSTANT PRICE BOOK A DELIVERY GET BUSINESS PRICING REQUEST A BUSINESS QUOTE
INSTANT PRICE CALCULATOR + BOOKING SYSTEM
I am interested in adding an automatic booking system.
I want customers to be able to:
1. Enter pickup address 2. Enter delivery address 3. Select package size/type 4. Select delivery speed/service 5. Select pickup date/time if applicable 6. Automatically calculate distance 7. Automatically calculate price using my pricing rules 8. Show subtotal, HST and final price 9. Enter customer information 10. Pay online 11. Receive confirmation 12. Send the complete order information to Cargaroo
Ideal customer flow:
Pickup → Drop-off → Price → Pay → Booking Confirmed
Payment should ideally support:
- Credit/debit card - Stripe - Apple Pay / Google Pay if available
I do NOT need a complicated Uber-style platform right now.
The first version mainly needs:
Addresses → Distance → Pricing Formula → Final Price → Payment → Confirmation
Please explain:
- Can you build this on Hostinger? - How would you build it? - Which Maps/Distance API would you use? - How would Stripe/payment work? - How would orders be sent to me? - How would customers receive confirmation? - What would this feature cost?
Please quote the calculator/booking system SEPARATELY from the SEO + website optimization work.
BUSINESS QUOTE SYSTEM
I also want to KEEP a separate Request Business Pricing / Request a Quote option.
This is for businesses needing:
- Recurring deliveries - Daily/weekly deliveries - High-volume deliveries - Dedicated routes - Contract pricing - Multiple stops - Custom delivery requirements
The long-term goal is to attract recurring B2B courier contracts.
SERVICE PAGES
I want useful, high-quality pages targeting services such as:
- Same-Day Courier Toronto - Business Courier Toronto - Rush Courier Toronto - Scheduled Business Delivery - Legal Document Delivery - Printing Company Delivery - Auto Parts Delivery - Same-Day GTA Delivery
Do NOT create dozens of low-quality or almost identical AI pages.
SERVICE AREAS
Relevant areas include:
- Toronto - North York - Scarborough - Etobicoke - Vaughan - Markham - Richmond Hill - Mississauga - Brampton
I want proper service-area SEO without spammy doorway pages.
TECHNICAL SEO
I need actual technical SEO implementation, including where appropriate:
- Google Search Console setup/verification - Check Google indexing - Fix indexing problems - Robots.txt - Noindex check - Canonical tags - XML sitemap - Sitemap submission - Request indexing for important pages - Google Analytics 4 - Conversion tracking - Mobile SEO - Page-speed improvements - Internal linking - Schema/LocalBusiness structured data - Broken-link checking - Duplicate-content checking
I want problems FIXED, not simply listed in a report.
ON-PAGE SEO
Optimize:
- Page titles - Meta descriptions - H1/H2/H3 headings - Content - Images/alt text - Internal links - URLs - Calls-to-action - Keywords
The homepage should target phrases such as:
Courier Service Toronto Same-Day Courier Toronto Delivery Service Toronto Same-Day Business Delivery Toronto
No keyword stuffing.
GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE / LOCAL SEO
I also need help optimizing my Google Business Profile, including:
- Categories - Services - Description - Service areas - Website connection - Business information consistency - Photos - Local citations - Google Maps/local SEO - Real customer review strategy
No fake reviews.
BACKLINKS
I want legitimate, relevant backlinks and citations.
I do NOT want:
- PBNs - Link farms - Spam backlinks - Automated backlink packages - Thousands of cheap backlinks - Black-hat SEO - Fake reviews
Explain what types of backlinks you plan to build before starting.
LEAD + CONVERSION TRACKING
My main goal is paying customers.
I want tracking for:
- Quote forms - Business quote requests - Phone clicks/calls - WhatsApp clicks - Contact forms - Delivery bookings - Online payments - Instant-price usage
I want to understand:
Traffic → Lead → Booking → Customer
REPORTING
Reports should show:
- Keyword rankings - Search Console impressions/clicks - Organic traffic - Indexed pages - Google Business Profile performance - Leads generated - Quote requests - Bookings - Website conversions - Work completed - Backlinks/citations created
PROJECT STRUCTURE
I prefer FIXED PRICE with milestones.
Possible milestones:
1. Technical SEO + Search Console + indexing 2. Website/design/conversion improvements 3. Service pages + keyword/local SEO 4. Delivery calculator + payment integration 5. Testing + tracking + reporting
I do not want to pay the entire project amount upfront.
BUDGET
Estimated total budget:
$1,500–$3,000 CAD depending on experience, quality and scope.
Please provide TWO separate prices:
A) SEO + WEBSITE OPTIMIZATION
B) INSTANT DELIVERY CALCULATOR + BOOKING/PAYMENT SYSTEM
I may hire the same freelancer for both.
BEFORE APPLYING, PLEASE ANSWER:
1. Have you ranked local service businesses before? 2. Have you worked with Canadian/Toronto businesses? 3. Have you worked with Hostinger? 4. Can you personally make changes to my Hostinger website? 5. Show me 2–3 websites you worked on. 6. Show Search Console results if available. 7. What are the FIRST 3 things you would change on Cargaroo.ca? 8. What would you do in the first 30, 60 and 90 days? 9. What keywords would you target? 10. What backlinks would you build? 11. How would you help generate actual leads? 12. Can you build the instant delivery calculator? 13. What API would you use for distance calculations? 14. Can you integrate online payments? 15. What would SEO + website optimization cost? 16. What would the calculator/booking system cost separately? 17. What access would you need? 18. How long would the project take?
Website: Cargaroo.ca
IMPORTANT:
Please ACTUALLY review Cargaroo.ca before applying.
At the beginning of your proposal, tell me the FIRST 3 THINGS you would change on my current website.
Generic/copy-and-paste proposals will not be considered.
I am looking for someone who understands both SEO/lead generation AND website conversion/development.
The goal is to turn Cargaroo.ca into a professional Toronto courier website that can rank on Google, generate business enquiries, and make it extremely easy for customers to book and pay for deliveries.

item.title: Monthly Band Website & FB Updates
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I front a busy classic-rock band and every new booking depends on how fresh our online presence feels. Each month I’ll pass along our confirmed gig dates, the best photos from the shows, and cut-down performance clips; your job is to turn that raw material into polished updates on both our website and our Facebook page.
Website • Add upcoming gig dates as event announcements that include venue, show time, ticket link (if any), and a short teaser line. • Upload 4-6 of the best photos from the previous month’s shows, plus one short video (YouTube or Vimeo embed is fine), making sure media is compressed for fast load times and properly captioned.
Facebook • Create a matching event post for every new date, tagging the venue and using our approved artwork. • Schedule one fan-engagement post per week—this can be a behind-the-scenes snapshot, trivia about the songs we cover, or a poll to pick the encore. • Upload one live performance clip per month, trimmed to under two minutes, with an engaging hook in the first sentence to boost reach.
Timing & Access I provide assets by the 3rd of each month. All website updates and the full slate of Facebook posts should be scheduled or live by the 7th. Admin access to both platforms will be granted in advance.
Acceptance Updates are considered complete when dates match the master schedule, media displays correctly on desktop and mobile, links work, and Facebook insights confirm that posts are properly scheduled.
If you’re comfortable juggling simple CMS editing, basic image/video optimisation, and social copy that sounds like a rock-n-roll stage banter, this will be a smooth, ongoing gig.

item.title: Multilingual Website Upgrade for Global Printer -- 2
item.description:
20000-50000 USD | We are a very large global label and packaging printer / converter. The majority of our revenue is driven from North America (USA), but we are significant players across all continents. We produce product labels for some of the most recognizable brands in the world. We have a broad portfolio of label solutions and print technologies.
We are seeking help to upgrade our website, with an emphasis on building in flexibility, self-service CMS, the appropriate security / protection and compliance, and easy navigation for our complex business. We do a modest amount of marketing pointed to the website, with a plan to drive more traffic in the future. We integrate our site with Salesforce to track and assign leads. We'd like to be able to add pages as needed (new product launches, for example), easily change photos and content on standard pages, and create thought leadership content with something like a blog.
Our website needs to be in multiple languages to accommodate our many regions.
One of our regions developed an e-commerce site outside of our parent platform - I'd like to explore if we can bring their e-commerce needs under the umbrella of this new site as well. It's not the highest priority, but if there's functionality to allow us to do that, the better.

item.title: WordPress Speed & SEO Overhaul
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | My WordPress site needs a rapid, end-to-end tune-up so it loads lightning-fast, ranks higher, and drives more orders—ideally hitting 95+ on Google PageSpeed Insights. On-page SEO is the priority, but I also want stronger local visibility and a smoother sales funnel that feeds directly into Clover for online ordering.
Here’s what I’m aiming for:
• Performance & UX – Lighthouse / PageSpeed score of 95 or better on both mobile and desktop – Clean Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS all in the green) – No breakage across popular browsers and responsive breakpoints
• SEO & Content – Tight on-page optimisation: titles, schema, internal links, image alt text, and keyword-aligned copy – Local SEO tweaks so the business shows up in the 3-pack for our main keywords – Tracking set up in Google Analytics 4 and Search Console for ongoing monitoring
• Clover Integration – Native or API-based ordering flow from the site straight to Clover without third-party widgets that slow things down – Menu sync and test transactions to confirm reliability
• Digital Marketing Basics – Branded social pages (Facebook, Instagram, X) connected to the site for easy sharing – A Mailchimp—or similar—email list ready to capture leads, with one welcome automation in place – Simple loyalty programme touchpoint at checkout to start collecting repeat-purchase data
Acceptance criteria 1. PageSpeed Insight score ≥95 after cache clear 2. All primary pages pass Core Web Vitals in Search Console 3. Test order successfully lands in Clover dashboard 4. At least one scheduled social post and one email automation in place, both pulling cleanly from onsite content 5. Full hand-off document outlining what was changed and how to maintain results
To move quickly (I’d like this done ASAP), you’ll need: – WordPress admin and hosting panel access – Clover merchant API credentials – Any premium plugin licences you prefer to use (e.g., WP Rocket, Rank Math Pro) if they aren’t already installed
When you reply, please include: • Two or three live WordPress sites you’ve pushed to 90+ PageSpeed with similar SEO work • A brief outline of your process and estimated timeline • Anything else you’ll need from my side to start right away
Looking forward to collaborating and seeing this site finally perform the way it should.

item.title: SharePoint Team Hub Development
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I want a single SharePoint site that acts as the central hub for my whole team. The core idea is simple: everything anyone needs—resources, documents, brand assets, onboarding material, and upcoming-event details—should sit in one clean, well-structured place.
Scope of the build • Home landing page that instantly signals “one-stop shop” and routes users to the right zone in one click. • Onboarding zone with checklists, policies, key contacts, and a place new hires can acknowledge completion. • Brand zone housing approved logos, colour guides, presentation templates, and any future brand updates. • Upcoming events space showing calendars, key deadlines, and announcements; ideally fed from Outlook or a shared calendar so we update once and the site reflects it automatically. • Quick-link panel for every employee’s personal folder (stored in their OneDrive or a dedicated document library). Inside those folders staff must be able to drag and drop Timesheets, Invoices, and Project files without extra permission prompts.
Key requirements – Clean page layouts built with modern SharePoint (no classic pages). – Intuitive navigation and search so even first-time users find content fast. – Proper permissions: the shared areas stay read-only for most, while each personal folder remains private to its owner and their manager. – Mobile-friendly design; most of our team checks info from phones. – Straightforward hand-over notes so I can maintain zones, update web parts, or add new sections after go-live.
Deliverables 1. Fully configured SharePoint site template ready for launch. 2. Documentation covering site architecture, libraries, permissions, and how to add future pages or lists. 3. Brief walk-through (live or recorded) showing me where and how to manage the hub.
If you have experience building modern SharePoint communication or team sites that blend document management, onboarding flows, and branded resources, let’s get this rolling.

item.title: Modern Informational Banner Design
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m refreshing my website visuals and need a set of modern-styled banners that immediately convey key product details to visitors. The goal is purely informational—no hard-sell language or flashing promos—so the design should feel clean, contemporary and on-brand while making the product specs or feature highlights easy to absorb at a glance.
Please roll out a cohesive family of banners that can live in hero sections, sidebars and in-content slots without losing their impact. Consistent typography, color harmony and intuitive hierarchy are critical so users can recognize the product focus wherever a banner appears.
Deliverables • 3-5 responsive banner variants sized 2560x300px / 1274x300px / 840x540px for typical desktop, tablet and mobile breakpoints • Layered source files (PSD, AI or Figma) plus web-ready PNG or JPG exports • A quick style guide outlining fonts, color codes and spacing rules so I can extend the look in future updates
I’ll supply logos, product imagery and any copy as soon as we kick off; feel free to suggest tighter wording or layout tweaks if it will improve clarity. Let’s create banners that look fresh and modern while giving visitors exactly the product information they came for.

item.title: Minimalistic Blog Website Design
item.description:
750-1500 GBP | I'm looking for a talented web designer to create a minimalistic exterior cleaning website. The primary focus of the site will be services.
Key requirements: - Design a clean, user-friendly layout that emphasizes readability and a seamless user experience. - Incorporate a minimalistic design aesthetic with a focus on simplicity and elegance.
Ideal skills and experience: - Proven experience in designing minimalistic websites, particularly for blogs. - Strong portfolio showcasing previous work. - Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and popular content management systems (CMS) like WordPress. - Ability to create responsive designs that work well on both desktop and mobile devices. - Excellent communication skills for collaboration and feedback.
Please include examples of your previous work in your bids. Looking forward to your proposals!

item.title: HubSpot Alumni Portal Build
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need a developer who knows HubSpot inside-out to stand up a secure, private alumni portal. The immediate focus is a log-in flow that uses Single Sign-On so former students can authenticate once and move seamlessly through the site.
Inside the portal I want an alumni directory that feels polished and easy to navigate. Users must be able to search or filter the database, open an individual profile page, and view listed contact details without exposing anything publicly. The portal will sit behind a secure, well-documented API; safeguarding personal data is non-negotiable, so please be comfortable with HubSpot’s security settings, GDPR best practice and any custom middleware needed.
The same environment will house a small billing area. After log-in, alumni should be able to download invoices, pay online and review their full transaction history. Stripe or HubSpot Payments are both acceptable if you have a strong preference.
Deliverables • SSO-enabled log-in page connected to HubSpot contacts • Alumni directory with search/filter, profile pages and contact display • Billing module: invoice generation, online payment gateway, transaction history • Clean, secure API endpoints plus basic documentation
Once the portal is live, I would appreciate a short walkthrough (recorded is fine) covering how to set up future events and manage the billing tools myself, but that training is secondary to getting the log-in and directory working flawlessly.
If you have recent HubSpot CMS or custom API examples, share a link and outline the stack you used. I am ready to start as soon as we agree on the best approach.

item.title: Full Stack Sysop and Webmaster. Ongoing work. WP expert.
item.description: 15-25 USD/hr | Full Stack Developer For Websites Ongoing Launch a new instance on our hosting company. Maintain and upgradde existing sites on Hostgator

item.title: Cold Email Domain Warming & Outreach
item.description:
8-15 CAD/hr | I need an experienced cold-email specialist to take a fresh domain from zero to full inbox-ready status, then run a B2B lead-generation campaign that drives sign-ups through our contact forms.
Scope of work • Configure the domain correctly—SPF, DKIM, DMARC, custom tracking, dedicated sending inboxes—and warm it gradually so we avoid spam filters. • Build or clean a prospect list that matches our B2B ICP. • Write and schedule persuasive email sequences (initial touch + logical follow-ups) focused on delivering value and prompting a quick sign-up. • A/B-test subject lines, calls-to-action, and send times to maximise open and reply rates. • Set up analytics so we can measure inbox placement, opens, clicks, and conversion to form completions. Connect results to Google Sheets or a simple CRM for easy review.
Tools you are comfortable with—Lemlist, Woodpecker, Mailshake, GMass, or similar—are fine as long as they support proper warming, sequencing, and reporting.
Acceptance criteria 1. Domain health scores in green and ≥90 % inbox placement on test sends. 2. Campaign achieves at least 30 % open rate and measurable sign-ups recorded in our forms dashboard. 3. All assets (email copy, lists, performance reports) handed over in editable format.
If this is your daily bread and you can start right away, let’s talk.

item.title: Website Consolidation & Sister Sites Setup
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I manage a number of business websites, domains and Outlook mailboxes that sit with different providers. The patchwork has become hard to maintain, so I want everything brought under one roof and given a light facelift before I launch two new sister companies.
Here is what I need done:
• Map the current landscape – domain registrars, hosting accounts, SSL, DNS, Outlook mailboxes – and produce a simple migration plan. • Migrate the existing sites and email to a single, reliable host (I’m open to your recommendation). • While moving, tidy each site’s navigation, refresh page structure and update dated content or design elements so the branding feels consistent across the group. • Build and publish two small-to-medium business websites for the new sister companies, matching the refreshed look of the parent brand. • Create new Outlook mail accounts for those companies and make sure DNS records (MX, SPF, DKIM) are correct after the move. • Set up and link core social media profiles (at minimum Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram) so the websites and socials cross-reference cleanly. • Hand over a concise cheat-sheet so my team can handle basic edits and future account renewals.
The work can be done in WordPress, Squarespace, Wix or a stack you’re comfortable with, although my strong preference is Wix — I need to keep long-term maintenance simple and cost-effective. Strong DNS and email migration experience is essential.

item.title: Single-Page Business Website Front-End
item.description: 250-750 USD | We are an e-commerce company from Singapore. We are looking for a front-end developer. We have several websites that require excellent front-end design, rather than uniform templates. We dislike rigid templates and require the developer to be proficient in HTML and PHP, and have their own understanding of the aesthetics of the website, being able to understand the different design concepts of B2B and B2C business websites. The task is relatively simple, and the estimated time is about five days. Before starting, I need a test. I will provide several products and a reference website. You make the homepage and let me have a look. I don't need a complete website or a real website structure. I only need an HTML test. I need to ensure that you have a very solid design foundation. Your design can be freely expressed, allowing me to see your design concept. If there is no problem, I will provide the work details and contract to start this cooperation.

item.title: Premium Barbershop Site Development
item.description:
250-750 USD | I am looking for an experienced web designer/developer to create a premium, modern website for a men’s barbershop brand. The website should feel high-end, masculine, creative, modern, and editorial, with a strong visual identity. This is not intended to look like a generic barbershop template.
Website Goals The website should: -Present the brand professionally. -Showcase men's haircuts and grooming services. -Allow clients to easily book appointments. -Build credibility and brand recognition. -Showcase haircut portfolio and transformations. -Work exceptionally well on mobile. -Be optimized for Google/search engines -Be easy for me to update without coding. - Haircut Lookbook / Portfolio A visually impressive gallery showcasing. -Booking Integrate an appointment-booking system. -Reviews. Google reviews integration or review section.Star ratings.Client testimonials. - Contact / Location,Location,Hours,Phone, Email,Google Maps, Social media links, Booking CTA.
Milestone 1 — Design Concept Homepage design,Mobile homepage, Typography,Color system, Navigation,Overall visual direction
Milestone 2 — Website Development Build approved design, Responsive development,Main pages,CMS
Milestone 3 — Features Booking,Portfolio,Reviews,Contact/Maps, Social integration
Milestone 4 — SEO & Optimization SEO,Speed,Analytics,Mobile optimization, Testing
Milestone 5 — Final Delivery Final revisions Bug fixing Admin training Source files Website launch Budget: Please provide your best fixed-price quote based on the complete scope above. To apply, start your proposal with: “I DO.” This will help me identify freelancers who actually read the project description.

item.title: High-Converting Construction Landing Page
item.description:
750-1500 AUD | I want a single, conversion-focused landing page that quickly tells prospects what we do in the construction space, then nudges them to sign up for updates. Copy must be razor-sharp—think the fewest words possible while still being crystal-clear.
Primary action • Sign-up form placed above the fold, collecting name, email, phone, company name, and who the head decision-maker is.
Look & feel I’m less concerned with whether it reads as “corporate,” “friendly,” or “innovative” and more concerned with whatever design and tone will convert best. Motion, subtle interactivity, or other dynamic touches are welcome if they strengthen clarity.
Core deliverables • Responsive landing page (desktop & mobile) • Clean, editable source files (HTML/CSS/JS, Webflow, or similar—open to your recommendation) • Simple back-end or integration that pipes submissions to my chosen CRM/email list • Clear hand-off notes so I can tweak copy or images later
Acceptance criteria 1. Load time under 3 seconds on mobile. 2. Headline, sub-headline, and CTA visible without scrolling on standard laptop screen. 3. Test submission arrives in my inbox/CRM with all requested fields populated.
If you’ve built landing pages that convert for B2B or construction before, show me. Let’s get this live fast so we can start building our prospect list.

item.title: Modern WordPress Portfolio Build
item.description:

* 24/7 automated uptime monitoring and alerts * Monitoring for HTTP 5xx/504 errors and other availability issues * Linode/server monitoring, including unusual traffic or resource usage * October CMS, PHP and database maintenance * Security and dependency updates * Cloudflare/DNS support where required * Backup monitoring and the ability to restore the site if necessary * GitHub/source-code and deployment support * Investigation of server/application errors when they occur * Reasonable response times for urgent issues affecting the live website * Occasional development/fixes, which could be charged separately if appropriate
We recently had an incident where the website returned 504 Gateway Timeout errors for approximately 16 minutes during a site crawl. Unfortunately, Google Ads attempted to access the website during this period and subsequently disapproved a significant number of our advertisements because it considered the destination unavailable. This has highlighted the need for appropriate monitoring and someone available to investigate these issues when they occur.
Our current developers have carried out substantial remediation and development work, so we would arrange a proper technical handover and provide access to the relevant systems and documentation.
We would like a quote for ongoing maintenance with additional development charged separately or another arrangement you would recommend.
Could you please let me know:
1. Whether you currently support existing October CMS websites; 2. Whether you are comfortable supporting Linode/Linux, Cloudflare, PHP and the associated server infrastructure; 3. What monitoring and emergency response you would provide; 4. Your typical response time if the live website goes down; 5. What would be included within a monthly maintenance package; 6. Your monthly cost; 7. Your hourly rate for work outside the maintenance package; and 8. Whether there would be any initial onboarding/handover charge.
The website is commercially important to us, so I’m looking for a long-term relationship with someone who can maintain the existing platform reliably, rather than someone looking to replace or rebuild it.
I’d be happy to arrange a call and provide further technical information if required before you quote.
Kind regards,
Amanda George Managing Director Quick Will Limited t/a Free Wills FreeWills.co.uk

item.title: UI/UX Designer – MudBlazor-First, Responsive Multi-Platform SaaS UI (Remote, AEST-Aligned) -- 2
item.description:

The same design language must feel natural: • In a browser • Inside a desktop shell (e.g. .NET MAUI) • On mobile screens
Responsive, multi-platform thinking is required from the first wireframe onward.
This is NOT A Figma-only role.
Every design must be implementable in MudBlazor using Blazor-friendly CSS and design tokens.
What you’ll do • Translate existing user flows and rough sketches into: ○ High-fidelity mockups ○ Clickable prototypes • Design core system-defining screens, including: ○ A data-rich analytics dashboard (charts, tables, KPIs) ○ A flexible user profile area • Use these screens to establish: ○ Layout patterns ○ Navigation behaviour ○ Modals, dialogs, and settings conventions • Design responsive layouts for: ○ Web (desktop) ○ Tablet ○ Mobile (down to ~360px) • Apply CSS and theming to extend MudBlazor: ○ Typography ○ Spacing ○ Density ○ Visual hierarchy • Ensure designs: ○ Map cleanly to MudBlazor components ○ Avoid custom UI elements that fight the framework • Collaborate closely with developers and provide regular written status updates during AEST hours
Deliverables • Low- and high-fidelity designs for Web, Desktop, and Mobile breakpoints • A reusable design system aligned to: ○ MudBlazor variables ○ Typography and spacing rules • Handoff package including: ○ Component mappings ○ Color palette ○ Interaction notes ○ Responsive behaviour guidance
Acceptance criteria (examples) • No layout shifts at desktop, tablet, or mobile breakpoints • Dashboard charts, tables, and KPIs remain readable at 360px width • All core profile actions (edit details, password reset, avatar upload) complete in ≤ 3 interactions
Required experience (must have) • Proven UI/UX design experience for responsive SaaS applications • Strong CSS skills, especially in component-based systems • Hands-on experience working with Blazor • Strong familiarity with MudBlazor (or real Blazor + MudBlazor projects) • Experience designing within an existing component library • Ability to explain design trade-offs clearly • Availability overlapping AEST hours
Nice to have • Experience exporting design tokens from Figma / XD / Sketch • Familiarity with Material Design 2.0 • Experience designing data-heavy dashboards • Light Blazor / Razor component awareness
Compensation • AUD $8 – $15 per hour • Open to per-screen or milestone pricing
Short design validation task (unpaid, shortlisted only) Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small, time-boxed design task. Not production work. Not used commercially. ≤ 2 hours. Example: • Design one responsive dashboard screen using MudBlazor • Show desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts • Map key elements to MudBlazor components • Include brief CSS/theming notes
How to apply To confirm you’ve read this: • Start your proposal with: MudBlazor + CSS • Share relevant work • Briefly explain how you design for responsive, multi-platform UI using component libraries
If you enjoy defining product-level UX that developers can implement with minimal friction, this role is for you.
